hue-neutral.purpose: Cool slate tint for all neutral surfaces and operator tokens.

body.purpose: Default interface text, metadata, shortcut labels.

mono.purpose: Expressions, results, variable names, console output.

label.purpose: Uppercase section headers and toolbar labels.

title.purpose: Inspector titles, plot headers, brand weight.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Toolbar actions: Clear, LaTeX toggle, plot controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: var(--bg-active); color: var(--fg-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--fg-primary); border-color: var(--fg-secondary); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button Danger
components.description: Destructive actions such as Reset VM.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost-danger { background: var(--bg-active); color: var(--status-error); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--status-error) 45%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease-out, border-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost-danger:hover { border-color: var(--status-error); } .ds-btn-ghost-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--status-error); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: REPL Input
components.description: Primary expression entry at the bottom of the console.
components.html: ➜
components.css: .ds-input-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--bg-panel); padding: 12px 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); } .ds-prompt { color: var(--color-keyword); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 700; } .ds-input-repl { flex: 1; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--fg-primary); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 14px; caret-color: var(--color-keyword); } .ds-input-repl::placeholder { color: var(--fg-secondary); } .ds-input-repl:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Panel Header
components.description: Uppercase section label for sidebar panels.
components.css: .ds-panel-header { padding: 10px 16px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; color: var(--fg-secondary); background: var(--bg-panel); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }

components.name: List Item
components.description: Clickable quick-ref row; inserts expression into REPL input.
components.css: .ds-list-item { width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 6px 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--fg-primary); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-list-item code { color: var(--color-keyword); } .ds-list-label { color: var(--fg-secondary); font-family: var(--font-ui); } .ds-list-item:hover { background: var(--bg-active); } .ds-list-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Status Indicator
components.description: WASM runtime connection state in the header.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-ui); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg-secondary); background: var(--bg-active); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-status-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--fg-secondary); } .ds-status.ready { color: var(--status-success); border-color: var(--status-success); } .ds-status.ready .ds-status-dot { background: var(--status-success); }

components.name: Variable Row
components.description: Sidebar variable entry with type badge and truncated value.
components.css: .ds-var-item { width: 100%; padding: 6px 16px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-var-name { color: var(--color-variable); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; } .ds-var-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-var-type { font-size: 9px; color: var(--fg-secondary); text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-var-value { color: var(--color-number); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 12px; } .ds-var-item:hover { background: var(--bg-active); } .ds-var-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Log Entry
components.description: Console output block with prompt line and result.
components.css: .ds-log-entry { margin-bottom: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--bg-active) 25%, transparent); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-log-input { color: var(--fg-secondary); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-log-result { color: var(--fg-primary); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-log-result.number { color: var(--color-number); }

narrative.overview:
MathZig Console is a workstation surface for engineers and scientists who evaluate expressions, inspect variables, and plot results without leaving a REPL mindset. The interface borrows the spatial logic of an IDE (header, sidebar, console, input bar) but strips away file-tree chrome. Density is a feature: monospace output, tight panel headers, and syntax-colored values let users scan numbers and types at speed.

The system is dark-first because the primary scene is a developer at a desk, often in a dim room, running repeated evaluations while watching console output and variable state. Surfaces use cool slate neutrals (hue 255) for clarity over long sessions.
keyCharacteristics: IDE-native three-pane layout: sidebar (260px), console (flex), input bar (fixed bottom)
Syntax-colored output with independent hues, not warm-neutral bleed
Compact 11–13px type scale tuned for data density, not marketing display
Tonal layering for depth; shadows reserved for modals and mobile drawer
REPL-first interaction: keyboard history, click-to-insert examples, variable inspector

rules.name: The Syntax-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Syntax palette colors appear only on typed content (keywords, numbers, strings, types). UI chrome stays neutral slate plus Focus Cyan. Never splash syntax aqua on a button background.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Surface hierarchy is conveyed by background step (inset → app → raised → panel → active), not by colored side stripes or gradient fills on panels.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Any user-authored or computed value renders in JetBrains Mono. Inter is for chrome, never for numbers the user is evaluating.

rules.name: The Fixed Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes are fixed rem/px steps (9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14). No fluid clamp headings. Sidebar and console density must not shift with viewport width.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Sidebar sections, toolbar, and log entries are flat at rest. Elevation is a response to overlay or runtime state, never default decoration.

dos: Do use CSS custom properties from :root for all new surfaces and text colors.
Do render computed values, expressions, and variable names in JetBrains Mono.
Do keep panel headers at 11px uppercase with 0.5px letter-spacing.
Do use border-subtle (1px) for dividers between panels, table cells, and plot frames.
Do reserve status-success, status-error, and status-warn strictly for runtime state.
Do collapse long console output with <details> rather than infinite scroll blocks.
Do label range sliders with <label for="id"> (see Lorenz controls pattern).
donts: Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent on list items, log entries, or callouts. Use background tint or full borders instead.
Don't apply backdrop-filter blur on overlays. Use solid tinted bg-overlay.
Don't use decorative gradients on icons, status pills, or panel headers.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff. Tint neutrals toward hue-neutral.
Don't load syntax colors onto button backgrounds or panel chrome.
Don't hide the entire sidebar on mobile without providing an alternative path to variables and quick-ref commands.
Don't set outline: none globally without :focus-visible replacements.
Don't add marketing hero metrics, card grids, or modal-first flows for features that fit inline in the console.
